text:
nina: Onboarding OrionRT13b-int8 here. Short completions look fine but when we push >1200 tokens outputs start repeating small clauses and factuals drift. attaching short repro and sample outputs.

sam: repro + runtime? int8 pack flags?

nina: running on dedicated int8 nodes (ded-gpu-6). conversion used `convert-tool v3` with `--pack interleave_heads --rotary-mode auto-scale`. tokenizer pack enabled. repro: ```bash
rdm-run --model /mnt/models/orionrt13b/int8 --prompt long_case.txt --max-tokens 1800 --seed 42
```
Output: coherent until ~1.1k then falls into repeating "then" clauses and entities swap.

eric: this smells like a rotary indexing / head packing mismatch or token id aliasing from tokenizer packing. can you dump kv-cache keys vs fp16 baseline for a long run?

nina: running kv diff now. also saw embeddings cosine drift ~0.15 after 1024 tokens.

devx-bot: queued job orionrt13b-int8-smoke (runner: ded-smoke-3). log: https://ci.internal/runs/9912

sam: quick glance at artifacts — kv keys align until token ~768, then a pattern where every 128 tokens certain head groups show phase flip. Looks like interleave_heads pack changed stride expectation in the runtime kernel. attach: /tmp/orion_kv_patch.txt

eric: interleave_heads + auto-scale rotary is risky. If rotary sin/cos generation assumes per-head contiguous layout but pack is interleaved, the sin/cos index calculation will misaddress. Over long context that accumulates as phase slip and then collapse.

nina: any quick confirm test?

sam: try rebuilding quant with `--pack separate_heads --rotary-mode explicit --preserve-tokenmap` and regen sin/cos per head, then rerun the long prompt. I'll kick CI.

ci-bot: rebuild job started: https://ci.internal/artifacts/9912/rebuild. (runner ded-convert-7)

ci-bot: rebuild finished: status=0. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/9912/orionrt13b-int8-rebuilt.tgz

sam: re-ran long run on rebuilt artifact. no collapse up to 2k tokens, embed cos sim delta ~0.02 vs fp16 baseline. So separate_heads + explicit rotary stable.

eric: ok actionable list: 1) add convert-time check that pack=interleave only allowed when runtime kernel is built/validated for that packing 2) emit sin/cos table metadata and per-head lengths in artifact 3) add longctx (2k) smoke to int8 onboarding matrix 4) emit tokenmap packing map so we can scan for sentinel/pad aliasing.

nina: I'll open the convert PR to default to separate_heads unless `--force-interleave` and add the preflight assert.

sam: also add a test in kernel CI to validate rotary indexing with interleaved layouts (small synthetic test) so we catch this earlier.

devx-bot: created ticket CONVERT-428: "prevent unsafe head-interleave + rotary auto-scale" and linked PR draft.

nina: thanks all, tagging @sam for review and @eric for kernel test. closing triage until sweep finishes. :coffee:

sam: running overnight sweep across wheel of models (Orion, Nebula, Zephyr) with new convert flags. will report back in morning.
